What needs

WHEN TO CONVENE

01
Competing priorities.

Several initiatives need the same resources. Which deserves commitment?

02
AI in consequential work.

AI is entering important workflows. Who may approve, challenge or stop its actions?

03
Agreement without action.

A direction is agreed, but departmental incentives keep pulling people apart.

QUESTIONS TO RESOLVE

01
The decision and its constraints.

Which question must be resolved, and what will the team stop doing?

02
AI review points.

Where must a person review the evidence or authorise the next step?

03
Ownership and review.

Who owns the decision, and what evidence would justify revisiting it?
